headline: SalesDesk day 1: 40 cycles, the hosted site is live on Azure behind Microsoft login, and the proposal, email and estimating workflows reps asked for are in

shipped.result: Single-file CRM published privately; 7,034 deals, 2,379 accounts, FY2026 plans loaded as published files; live edits in the shared database; local mode for testing.
shipped.businessReason: Leaves Pipedrive without losing five years of history or paying per-seat fees.

shipped.result: Drag-to-stage board, weighted forecast by close month, won/lost list; stage inferred from Pipedrive weighted probability.
shipped.businessReason: One view of $124M open across seven brands; weighting gives a defensible forecast.

shipped.item: Accounts with site clustering and merge review
shipped.result: 2,681 Pipedrive org names grouped into accounts with sites; 176 proposed groups for confirm/split; AI check; PM base and whitespace lists.
shipped.businessReason: Customer consolidation is the precondition for cross-brand account management and the PM flywheel.

shipped.item: Quotes with bid options and GPMD
shipped.result: Crew x days, cost lines, options; GPMD vs brand floor with chase/reprice/pass and price-to-clear; deal value syncs from the selected option.
shipped.businessReason: Makes R. Brooks' estimating discipline the platform default at bid time.

shipped.result: Generated from a quote in each brand's identity with official hex codes; downloadable standalone HTML.
shipped.businessReason: Consistent, fast proposals across brands without a designer.

shipped.item: GPMD & Plan, Analytics, Team, Assistant, Setup
shipped.result: Capacity in man-days vs crews, orders/quote plan vs actual by brand and rep, win rates, aging, multi-year; roles and groups; AI intake, coach, scope writer; GPMD and brand settings.
shipped.businessReason: Management layer from day one so the tool is a sales operating system, not a contact list.

cycles.verification: Headless Chromium on the local build: every route and sub-tab at 1400px and 400px, light and dark, zero console errors, no horizontal scroll; functional chain (new deal with account match → stage → quote → GPMD → add option → proposal → merge confirm/split → mark won → persisted) passed. Live page: one shared-database read at interact level confirmed the backlog is readable; 76 documents seeded (74 reps, settings, backlog).
cycles.couldNotVerify: The live claude.ai page itself (sign-in, AI calls, downloads) was not driven by a browser; local mode stood in for the shared database.
defectsFixed: Derived state not recomputed after local writes
Past-dated deals shown as closing soon
Lost-value outliers skewing value win rate

salesAgentTop3: Quick log with next action and a Today list (the ten-second test)
A bid you can build and send: templates, typed markups, tax, lead time; numbered, licensed proposal with rep contact
Contacts and files, the two reasons a rep still opens Pipedrive

shipped.result: Quote edits no longer overwrite deal value or stage; blank GPMD settings fall back to defaults; blank close date defaults to today; lost reason is required.
shipped.businessReason: Forecast and FY bookings cannot move without a human pricing or closing something.

shipped.result: Log button on every card, row, deal and Home item: type chips, note, next action date and text, optional stage and close change, tap-to-call. Home Today lists follow-ups due and deals cold 21+ days.
shipped.businessReason: Activity that takes ten seconds gets logged; next dates make the forecast real.

shipped.result: Sixth tab reaches Plan, Analytics, Team, Setup on a phone.
shipped.businessReason: GM and CEO can run month-end from a phone.

shipped.result: Deals, accounts, quotes and proposals have shareable links that survive reload.
shipped.businessReason: A CRM nobody can link into does not displace Pipedrive.

shipped.result: Won/lost updates linked quote and proposal status; won value pre-fills from the quote.
shipped.businessReason: Capacity and proposal lists agree with the pipeline.

shipped.result: Verdict waits for costs; shows GM at the clearing price and man-days to cut; reprice band editable; floor calculator from overhead ÷ billable man-days.
shipped.businessReason: Estimators get levers, not a grade.

shipped.result: Quote and proposal numbers (BRAND-YYYY-NNN, revisions), rep phone/email, brand license in footer; download blocked when scope is empty.
shipped.businessReason: Hospital AP can cut a PO against it; Florida license rule met.

notShipped.why: Today list shipped for all roles; sales-specific plan line and hygiene hiding done; closing-soon per rep and my-week summary next cycle.

cycles.couldNotVerify: Live claude.ai page not driven by a browser; sign-in linking flow exercised only in code review.

shipped.result: Created, advanced, won, lost since Monday with activities by rep and the deals that moved.

shipped.result: Lost reasons by reason, value and brand (required on every loss from go-live).

shipped.result: Generated on Home for management: week movement, coverage of FY gap, brand month vs plan, largest deals closing; copies as text.

shipped.result: Nine logos fetched from SharePoint, compressed and rendered on proposal covers.

shipped.result: Eight buckets with top reps per bucket; price now shows as a near tie for second; no-response losses name the reps.
shipped.businessReason: Turns 1,800 free-text losses into a Monday coaching list.

shipped.item: Labor hours to GPMD (P28) and proposal age (P29)
shipped.result: One click prices a Pipedrive-estimated bid against the brand floor; proposal-to-close medians per brand with a stuck list of open proposals past 2x.
shipped.businessReason: Real numbers through the GPMD floor today, and a follow-up cadence per brand.

cycles.verification: tools/test9.js (27 assertions) plus all prior suites, zero console errors.

shipped.result: Confirm Pipedrive parent hints, roll children up on the parent page and in Analytics, see which accounts buy from more than one brand and which big single-brand customers are the cross-sell list.

cycles.verification: tools/test10.js plus all suites, zero console errors.

shipped.result: 41 agreements renew in the next 120 days; one click opens the renewal deal at the prior value and links it back.
shipped.businessReason: Renewals stop slipping silently; the PM base compounds instead of churning.

cycles.verification: tools/test11.js plus all suites, zero console errors.

cycles.verification: tools/test12.js plus all suites, zero console errors.

shipped.result: A pipeline snapshot is recorded every week automatically; trends and week-over-week movement now work for imported deals too; importer carries stage-change, bid-due and proposal dates; renders stay under 60 ms at 7,034 deals.

cycles.verification: tools/test13.js plus all suites, zero console errors.

shipped.result: Reps mark deals commit, best case or omit; the Forecast tab and the CEO brief show commit vs plan by rep for this month and next; bid due dates drive a Home card and list sort.

cycles.verification: tools/test14.js plus all suites, zero console errors.

shipped.result: Each brand's palette is its own named tokens from the brand skills and standards, with fonts and source; Setup shows them by name and hex; proposals use the tokens.
shipped.businessReason: Proposals and the brand setup read like the brand guides, not a template.

shipped.result: Click any rep name to see their open bids with GPMD verdicts, won and lost this year, plan attainment, commit and activity.
shipped.businessReason: One click from any report to the conversation with the rep.

shipped.result: Below-floor bids cannot be sent by a rep without a brand manager's name and reason; commit at month start is scored against bookings.

cycles.verification: tools/test15.js, test16.js plus all suites, zero console errors.

shipped.result: Quality score per rep with every gap one click from its deals; Pipedrive-hour quotes open as real cost lines with the estimator named.

cycles.verification: tools/test17.js plus all suites, zero console errors.

shipped.item: Live-data snapshot in the published artifact
shipped.result: All shared collections exported to data/live.json and published beside the page; loaded whenever the shared database is unavailable, with local edits layered on top. Nightly build republishes it.
shipped.businessReason: CEO asked that the data be there when the site is visited directly; without it a direct visit showed only history, not live deals, quotes or users.

shipped.result: Won deals carry a job-system entry (system, job number, date, who); Home shows 'Won, not in ServiceTitan' for management with a pending list; Setup › Data exports a single CSV for the ServiceTitan job build and Intacct project setup.
shipped.businessReason: Won work must land in the job and accounting systems without retyping; the pending count is the control that nothing sold goes unbilled.

shipped.result: Paste an email on a deal: sender, date, subject and body are read, the quoted thread is stripped, the customer contact is matched or created, the deal contact is set, and the email is logged as activity with an optional next action and task.
shipped.businessReason: Half of selling happens in email; without it the weekly activity count and last-touch dates understate real work and the going-cold list lies.

shipped.result: Long tables page at 200 rows with a 'Show more' control; the PM-base and cross-sell tabs use the per-account index. PM tab render fell from 362 ms to 11 ms; every view renders under 60 ms at phone width.
shipped.businessReason: Reps on phones feel every full-table render; as history grows past 10,000 deals the app must stay instant or they drift back to Pipedrive.

shipped.item: Rep onboarding tour and training mode (P47)
shipped.result: A seven-step tour teaches the daily routine and stamps the rep as onboarded (visible in Team). Training mode gives each rep three practice deals that count toward nothing and can be reset.
shipped.businessReason: Leaving Pipedrive is a habit change; a guided first session and a safe sandbox beat a manual and protect the real numbers from practice entries.

shipped.result: Zero serious or critical axe-core findings on every main view in light and dark at desktop and phone width. Contrast fixed in both themes and on every brand's proposal cover; keyboard users can move a stage, open rows and close dialogs; screen readers get labelled controls and live toasts.
shipped.businessReason: Estimators on keyboards and reps on dark-mode phones must read every pill and move a stage; accessibility defects are adoption defects.

shipped.result: Source Sans 3 UI face at Pipedrive's conventions (14 px base, semibold headings, sentence-case pills), thin rounded line icons on nav and main actions. Brand fonts in proposals unchanged.
shipped.businessReason: Reps leaving Pipedrive should feel at home on the first morning; familiarity is adoption.

shipped.item: Hosted web app package with Microsoft sign-in (P60)
shipped.result: deploy/azure-swa: Azure Static Web Apps + Entra ID locked to the FSP tenant, Functions API over Cosmos DB, AI proxy with the key server-side, a shim so the identical page runs there, mock server and end-to-end test (owner, sales matched by name and linked, guest viewer). Runbook written; needs an Azure subscription owner to run infra/deploy.sh and add one DNS record.
shipped.businessReason: A real domain behind the Microsoft login staff already use is the precondition for pointing 74 reps at SalesDesk.

shipped.result: A refused write to an admin collection no longer flips a rep's session to view-only; non-admins record a sign-in with the matched rep instead of writing the roster. Verified against the hosted API as a sales rep.
shipped.businessReason: As written, every rep's first sign-in would have made them read-only; found by the PM review, confirmed by the web test.

shipped.result: Six verified defects and thirteen new backlog items (P54–P66) with acceptance criteria; P49 map retired.
shipped.businessReason: Keeps the nightly Opus runs pointed at money-trust defects (forecast scope, outliers, permissions) before features.

shipped.result: With a brand filter, as a brand manager or as a rep, the Forecast tab and the CEO brief now show only that scope's plan and reps; plan placeholders no longer appear as people.
shipped.businessReason: A GM reading the platform plan as his gap, or a rep seeing every other rep's plan, is the fastest way to lose trust in the forecast.

shipped.result: The $6.2B Weber data-entry outlier no longer tops Accounts or inflates an account header or Team counts; 'Last touch' now comes from activity.
shipped.businessReason: One absurd number at the top of a list discredits every correct number below it.

shipped.result: Every deal-changing path (quick log, quote, renewal, handoff) is gated to the rep's own deals; the assistant and rep cards only see the user's scope.
shipped.businessReason: Reps editing each other's deals, or pulling another brand's pipeline through the assistant, would end the pilot on day one.

shipped.result: Admins choose imported Pipedrive probability or stage-weighted; every weighted number states which basis it uses and how many deals still carry an imported probability.
shipped.businessReason: The board number must say what it is made of; today 880 open deals are weighted by a probability Pipedrive set in October.

shipped.result: Quotes warns which brands still run on the platform default floor; verdicts are labelled until the brand sets its own overhead and labor cost.
shipped.businessReason: A chase/reprice/pass verdict against a borrowed floor is fiction; the label makes the gap visible to the GM who must close it.

shipped.result: Every close-date push is recorded on the deal and surfaced: a Slipped row and list on This week, a stat and sentence in the CEO brief, and a per-rep slip count on Forecast.
shipped.businessReason: Sandbagging and optimism both show up as slips; until they were recorded, a rep could move a $500K close three times with no trace.

shipped.item: Brand forecast roll-up with week-over-week delta (P57)
shipped.result: Forecast opens with a by-brand table (won, commit, change in commit since last week's snapshot, best, weighted, plan, gap) whose platform total ties to the rep rows.

shipped.item: Two-step quick log and phone line cards (P66)
shipped.result: On a phone the log shows four fields, with stage, close and forecast one tap away; quote lines become readable cards.
shipped.businessReason: Ten seconds to log a call is the adoption promise; seven fields on a 400-pixel screen breaks it.

shipped.result: Setup › Data reconciles SalesDesk against the source export or last import by brand and flags any brand off by more than 1%.

shipped.item: Proposal rebuilt as a real document (P67, CEO direction)
shipped.result: Letterhead, numbered sections, existing conditions, equipment schedule, alternates priced against base, payment, schedule, warranty and a full acceptance block; prints to a clean letter PDF in every brand.
shipped.businessReason: Six-figure bids are won or lost on the document a facilities director forwards to their boss; it now looks like the brand's own proposal, not a web page.

shipped.item: Email from the deal and inbox sync (P68, CEO direction)
shipped.result: Reps send from their own Outlook with the deal tag in the subject and pull tagged or contact emails into the deal with one click; everything is logged as activity and moves last touch.
shipped.businessReason: Half of selling is email; without it the activity record and the going-cold list were fiction, and reps kept Outlook as the system of record.
shipped.verdict: met on claude.ai; hosted build follows via Microsoft Graph (P70)

shipped.result: Drop or paste an estimate; SalesDesk maps the columns, types the lines, converts labor hours to man-days and creates the quote with a GPMD verdict.
shipped.businessReason: Estimators price in Excel; a quote they do not have to retype is the only way GPMD gets recorded on every bid.

shipped.result: Cover letter, equipment data schedule (make, model, tons, efficiency, electrical), tax and totals per option, permit/tax/bond clarifications, milestone schedule, warranty by component, qualifications, insurance and references from a per-brand Proposal profile.

shipped.item: Hosted build: email through Microsoft Graph (P70)

shipped.verdict: met in the mock; needs admin consent at deploy

shipped.result: One copyable pack per brand: orders vs plan, commit to close, bids below floor and who approved them, renewals, stuck proposals, slips and data quality, all tied to the live cards.
shipped.businessReason: Without it every GM rebuilds the month in Excel from Pipedrive; with it the platform reads nine packs written the same way.

shipped.result: Each brand can set a sales@ mailbox that reps cc; one click files those emails onto deals by tag or contact and queues the rest for review.
shipped.businessReason: Customer email that never touches a rep's mailbox (shared sales@ addresses) now reaches the opportunity too, so the deal record is complete without asking anyone to forward.

shipped.item: Defect round on import, email and proposal (ten verified by the PM)
shipped.result: Column mapping, total-row and labor detection, sell-price source, duplicate-title deal picker, quoted cells, address parsing, per-deal email dedupe, cleared fields and license precedence all fixed with tests.

shipped.item: Hosted site live on Azure (P60) and light theme default
shipped.result: The CEO deployed FSP SalesDesk to Azure Static Web Apps from Cloud Shell behind Microsoft sign-in; data loaded; deploy scripts made resumable with a one-command publish; light theme default with a Light/Dark/Auto switch.
shipped.businessReason: A real address behind the login staff already use is the precondition for the rep rollout; dark mode by default was the first thing the CEO noticed.
shipped.verdict: met; custom domain, Anthropic key and Graph admin consent pending (owner actions)

openQuestions: Email scope is not available on this account, so role matching uses display name until users are linked on first sign-in.
Pipedrive stage names, notes, contacts and activities were not in the export; a fuller export would let P1 recover them.
Who owns the Azure subscription and DNS for salesdesk.flowservice.com? deploy/azure-swa/README.md is the 30-minute runbook.
Fresh Pipedrive People export with phones and e-mails (P50): tap-to-call is dead without it.
backlogTop5: Night 1 (tonight): forecast accuracy from snapshots (P38), GM sign-off for below-floor bids (P40)
Night 2: real cost lines from hours (P41), data-quality dashboard (P43)
Night 3: ServiceTitan handoff export (P44), email logging (P45)
Needs you: fresh Pipedrive export (Deals, Notes, People, Activities)
recommendation: Run a fresh Pipedrive export (Deals, Notes, People, Activities, CSV, all fields) and drop it into Setup › Data to cover deals created since June and the notes history; then have one R. Brooks estimator price a live bid in SalesDesk on Monday.
strategicObservation: The loss and labor history is the new asset: since FY2025 the platform lost 388 deals to no response (two R. Brooks reps account for half), price effectively ties competitor for second, Dynamic closes 14 days after a proposal while Altstadt takes 106, and 40 open Cortez bids carry estimated hours that can run through the GPMD floor today. GPMD discipline becomes platform culture only if SalesDesk is the estimating system of record first and the CRM second; the item that still needs the CEO is a fresh Pipedrive export (Deals, Notes, People, Activities): 647 open deals created since June have none of this detail, and every contact imported so far is a name without a phone number.

summary.shipped: 40 build cycles from v0.1.0 to v0.38.0: the five-night roadmap in one day (snapshots, forecast commit/best, GM sign-off, data quality, ServiceTitan handoff, email logging, paging, tour and training mode, accessibility), Pipedrive-style UI, two proposal rebuilds to facilities-director standard, Outlook email in and out of every deal plus shared intake mailboxes, estimator spreadsheet import, GM month-end pack, Pipedrive parity check, slips and brand forecast roll-up, rollout-safe permissions, and the Azure hosted build the CEO deployed himself.
summary.verified: Every cycle had a headless Playwright acceptance test and the regression suites were green before each publish; axe-core reports zero serious or critical findings in light and dark at desktop and phone width; the Microsoft 365 search result shape was verified against the CEO's mailbox; the hosted build passed its end-to-end test for owner, rep and guest identities and sent/synced mail through the mock Graph.
summary.couldNotVerify: Real Outlook send from the artifact (needs the CEO to allow the connector once); Graph mail on Azure (needs admin consent and the Exchange access policy); the custom domain (DNS pending); the proposal in a real customer's hands.
summary.notShipped: Fresh Pipedrive People export (owner action; phones and emails are still missing on every contact); brand proposal profiles and GPMD floors (GM inputs); P49 map retired.
openQuestions: Email scope is not available on this account, so role matching uses display name until users are linked on first sign-in.
Pipedrive stage names, notes, contacts and activities were not in the export; a fuller export would let P1 recover them.
Who owns the Azure subscription and DNS for salesdesk.flowservice.com? deploy/azure-swa/README.md is the 30-minute runbook.
Fresh Pipedrive People export with phones and e-mails (P50): tap-to-call is dead without it.
summary.recommendation: Point two or three reps at the hosted site next week with their own Microsoft login before any wider rollout; have each GM fill the brand GPMD floor and proposal profile first, because verdicts and proposals are only as good as those two inputs.
summary.strategicObservation: The asset that compounds is not the CRM screens, it is the GPMD record on every bid plus the proposal and email trail attached to it: that is the data no Pipedrive export ever held and the basis for pricing discipline across nine brands. Protect it by making SalesDesk the estimating system of record first; the activity CRM follows.
